facts.fact: Interior Minister Vagondo Diomandé said on 10 August 2024 that the national civil-status software Cityweb, run by ONECI, was being rolled out across the country's 690 civil-status centres, with 346 connected so far and births now registrable digitally from maternity wards.

CIV.note: Document states no identity number given at birth registration.
Civil-status centres connected to Cityweb are a civil registration application, not a stated connection of local government offices.

facts.fact: ONECI's Cityweb software lets a birth be registered digitally from the maternity ward, as announced on 10 August 2024.
Interior Minister Vagondo Diomandé said 346 of the 690 civil-status centres were connected to the national Cityweb software.
Interior Minister Vagondo Diomandé said 346 of 690 civil-status centres were connected to Cityweb (238 of 490 sub-prefectures and 108 of 201 town halls), with rollout continuing to all.
Cityweb is implemented by the national civil-status and identification office ONECI and presented by the Interior Minister.
